scope: R1-R5 cold metadata, native environment, ordinary API and evidence claims
checks: Identity comparisons use three independent owned byte ranges; incomplete or unknown identities cannot match a complete fixed model condition.
Allocation-size additions precede copying and are bounded by PTRDIFF_MAX; no runtime overflow claim is made from an invalid string_view.
Copy retains before release, move handles self-assignment, final release uses the original allocator; allocator backing lifetime is documented.
Common Direct, delegated preparation, operation and region Graph requests preserve the workload. Compute overwrites proposal workload after the Provider callback.
Prepared shape instances copy the fixed workload; Graph exact variants copy parent options and share constants only within one immutable compile family.
Invalid phase/region values are rejected before Provider qualification or native plan construction. Actual typed schema, effects and resource checks remain authoritative.
Apple and Vulkan retain their native Program/resource execution. New workload reads occur during cold lowering/compilation and explicit diagnostics.
CUDA environment collection finishes before explicit primary-context retention; the public snapshot is owned and the private borrow uses existing backend-lifetime preconditions.
CUDA driver_cuda_version is documented as the supported CUDA API level, not the driver package or patch version.
No new math, shader, SIMD algorithm, runtime model search, benchmark, performance winner, or model-coverage claim is introduced.
Windows fixture correction changes no product files. Original failed and passed selector receipts retain their original identities. Unrun environments remain pending.
limitations: Synthetic condition tests prove qualification and forwarding only; mature path samples remain small fragments, not whole-model coverage.
No cross-process or global plan cache is added, and workload equality alone is not a complete cache key.
Final correctness and delivery verdicts depend on the declared cross-platform and sanitizer runs; this source review does not sign those gates.
correction_review: R5a resolved a pre-existing native shared-export defect revealed by Air. Public MLX depends uses the same upstream primitive; cold stream precondition prevents default/foreign stream fallback. Source identity and exported-symbol evidence retained. Apple native Direct/Graph checks passed after correction; other pending gates remain unsigned.
packaging_review: R5b retains the existing asset/producer dependencies and installed helper identity. Each generated build script locks the destination resource directory through copy completion; separate directories remain independent. No lock is acquired by the application or native runtime. Actual delivery verdict remains pending until the declared queue completes.

checks: Original and continued Windows receipts jointly cover the exact 28 selected gates; their original commit identities and failure remain.
R5b selector and all nine pending checks passed; all four environment SDK receipts and command log hashes were checked, including source/shared/static ordinary Direct/Graph tests.
Public metadata sizes are checked against all twelve actual SDK footprint outputs, not inferred from source.
Original source reviews above retain their then-pending wording. The final execution verdict is recorded separately here, without changing old receipts or claiming a source review ran tests.
No new model coverage cell, timing result, provider winner, self-written operator extension or old BLOCKED-owner clearance is claimed.
